acceptanceCriteria: A recognised codex usage source is parsed into the estimate, or the spec records codex as unsupported with the refusal code.
Focused test pins the chosen behaviour.
body: Found by lane V1-1549 (dispatch context thresholds, PR beamfall/corvint#1016, head 4f95382a4, base 69c6cac03, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. CAL-V0-341 accepts estimates only from recognised claude-code and opencode events; Codex exposes no per-call context estimate, so a codex role cannot declare `context`. Expected: a supported codex estimate source or an explicit documented refusal.
title: Dispatch context thresholds for codex roles (no per-call context estimate)
